c02.summary: The claim that Card 3 turned out to be the Monarch is false. The recording shows Card 3 initially face down (call@6), then after tapping Card 2 (call@7), Card 3 revealed as "Blue Morpho" (call@8, screen after call@8). No reference to "Monarch" appears anywhere in the recording.
evidence: call@6: wait_for confirmed Card 3 was initially face down
call@7: tap on testid=card_2 (Card 2), not Card 3
call@8: wait_for succeeded for label="Card 3, Blue Morpho" — Card 3 revealed as Blue Morpho
screen after call@8 shows element @e4: "Card 3, Blue Morpho Blue Morpho (button)"
trace_search for "Monarch" returned 0 results — no Monarch card appears in the recording

c06.summary: The claim that cards 1 and 2 stayed face up after not matching is false. The recording shows that after tapping card_0 (Card 1), it revealed "Emerald Emerald" (face up), but after tapping card_1 (Card 2), both cards immediately showed "face down ?" — they turned face down. The test explicitly waits for "Card 2, face down" and "Card 1, face down" (calls 8 and 9), confirming the expected behavior is that mismatched cards flip back face down.
evidence: After first tap (call@6), Card 1 shows 'Card 1, Emerald Emerald' (face up), Card 2 shows 'Card 2, face down ?'
After second tap (call@7), both Card 1 and Card 2 show 'face down ?' — they have turned face down
call@8 waits for label 'Card 2, face down' and call@9 waits for label 'Card 1, face down', confirming the test expects mismatched cards to flip face down

c13.summary: The recording shows the app was terminated and launched (call@1, call@2), then a game was played and completed in 8 moves. The only check of the best score occurs at call@24 after the game, where the element testid=best reads "Best: 8 moves". There is no observation of the best score immediately after the restart, before the game was played. Therefore, the recording cannot establish whether the best score persisted from a prior session or simply reflects the game just completed.
evidence: App terminated and launched at start (call@1, call@2)
Game played with 16 card taps (8 pairs) resulting in 8 moves (call@6–call@21)
After game, wait_for testid=best confirms element says exactly "Best: 8 moves" (call@24)
No screen or wait_for captures best score before the game is played

c20.summary: The game did end in 8 moves (16 taps across calls call@6–call@21), but it did offer a way to play again: a "Play again" button is visible on the screen after the final move (call@21, call@22, call@23).
evidence: 16 taps (call@6 through call@21) correspond to 8 moves in the matching game
Screen after call@21 shows all 16 cards matched and a 'Play again' button at bottom center
Screen after call@22 (wait_for status) still shows the 'Play again' button
Screen after call@23 (wait_for pairs) still shows the 'Play again' button

c22.summary: The recording shows card_14 (the 15th card, zero-indexed) tapped at call@20, then card_15 (the 16th card) tapped at call@21. Thus Card 15 was tapped before Card 16, contradicting the claim.
evidence: call@20 taps testid=card_14 (the 15th card) at 34717 ms
call@21 taps testid=card_15 (the 16th card) at 36464 ms, after call@20

c25.summary: The game was won in 8 moves. The recording shows a memory matching game with 16 cards (8 pairs). The player made 16 taps on cards (call@6 through call@21), which constitutes 8 moves (each move = flipping two cards to find a match). After the 16th tap (call@21), all 16 cards display as "matched" and a "Play again" button appears, confirming the game was completed. The subsequent test (call@24) waiting for "Best: 8 moves" timed out with "No best yet," but this only indicates the best-score tracking didn't record the result, not that the game wasn't won in 8 moves.
evidence: 16 card taps recorded (call@6 through call@21), each tap flips one card in a memory matching game
After call@21, screen shows all 16 cards as 'matched' and a 'Play again' button, confirming game completion
call@22 wait_for testid=status succeeded, indicating game-end status appeared
call@24 failed waiting for 'Best: 8 moves' — the best-score label showed 'No best yet', but this is separate from whether the game was won in 8 moves
